hypothesis: The earlier time-scale comparison used a weak cell embedding; cell-init and time encoding may interact. Complete the missing paired t=1000, cell-std=1, noise=1 trial before attributing slow specificity learning to training length alone.
kept_paper_parameters: 12x768 Transformer, 12 heads, context32/layer4, v-loss/path/time distribution, dropout0.1, AdamW/betas/LR/effective batch/warmup/cosine, two EMA and Heun50 unchanged.
data: Training and validation only; no test cells. Use the same training subset and fixed validation noise.
selection: PDCorr + mean(PDS_L1,PDS_L2,PDS_cos), raw and clamped arrays separately; inspect paired perturbation bootstrap, MSE, cell centroid and variance. No automatic replacement of the full-training model based on one short raw-weight pilot.
limitations: 384-update raw-weight diagnostic, not mature EMA or full-training superiority; the current main run remains unchanged.
start_after: Completion of the epoch-10 paired CFG review and release of its GPU process; avoid three simultaneous GPU workloads.
